title: What goes into jelly's next release
ask: Everything logged this session, against two weeks. Move things until it is the release you want, then lock it.

items.label: Ask and get the answer in one command
items.why: The loop agents use most. Today it takes two commands and parsing an event.

items.label: jelly wait never misses a change
items.why: An answer given before wait connects is lost, and the agent blocks on it.

items.label: Each agent gets its own inbox
items.why: Only bites when two agents share one project.

items.label: jelly is running when an agent reaches for it
items.why: A stopped daemon is the likeliest reason an agent falls back to prose.

items.label: jelly ask says so when --at matches nothing
The first jelly see returns a snapshot
items.why: Cause found: Chrome posts its snapshot, then lingers, and see waits 20 s.

items.label: One line per item from every command
items.why: attention and ask --spec print raw JSON. Costs tokens, breaks nothing.

items.label: Only jelly's own pages can talk to the daemon
items.why: No Origin or Host check. Unconfirmed, and the repo is public: confirming is half the work.

items.label: Recipe: review a change
items.why: Shipped with a real review as its example.

items.label: Recipe: a live plan
items.why: Being built now. What is left is your look at it.

items.label: Recipe: triage a pile
items.why: Being built now. What is left is your look at it.

items.label: Recipe: a tradeoff to play with
items.why: This jelly. Being built now; the sums need a second pair of eyes.

items.label: Recipe: a map of the code
items.why: Being built now. Worth less until it is tried on a big repo.

items.label: Recipe: an incident timeline
items.why: Being built now. What is left is your look at it.

items.label: Recipe: a long run, live
items.why: Being built now. Needs a real long run to prove the push path.

items.label: jelly share keeps images named in state
items.why: Only assets named in the view are inlined, so a shared review loses its screenshots.

items.label: No panic when output is piped to head
items.why: `jelly new … | head -1` panics with Broken pipe. Ugly, harmless.

recommended.why: Hearing you first, then the daemon and the safety check. #3, #7, the map recipe and the pipe panic wait: 7 h that nobody is stuck on.
